IS 6748 : Part 1 : 2024 Recommendations for Watershed Management Relating to Soil Conservation - Part 1 Agronomic Aspects
ICS 93.160
ICS 93.160
WRD 06
WRD 06
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) covers the recommendations on the agronomical aspects for soil conservation in the catchment area and the appropriate method(s) to be adopted.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards:
